newsitem.title: RUSSIA: BASKETBALL-TARLAC LEADS OLYMPIAKOS TO VICTORY OVER CSKA.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-TARLAC LEADS OLYMPIAKOS TO VICTORY OVER CSKA.

text.p: Olympiakos deservedly beat CSKA Moscow 79-70 in EuroLeague Group E on Thursday to boost their chances of qualifying for the round of the last 16.

Inspired by Dragan Tarlac's 20 points, Olympiakos outplayed CSKA in defence and attack. They surged ahead in the opening stages, had a comfortable 41-30 lead at halftime and never looked like throwing it away.
The victory was vital for Olympiakos's hopes of reaching the next stage after losing to group leaders Stefanel Milan 73-71 last month.
CSKA's disappointed coach, Ivan Edeshko, had predicted the match would be decided in the opening 10 minutes but watched in horror as the Greeks seized the initiative early on.
CSKA, whose top scorer was Sergei Bazarevich with 20 points, now face a stiff task to qualify for the last 16 -- a disappointment after finishing third in last season's championship.
